"""Recompute domain/ADC weighting summaries from all actual training-unit records."""
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V164-pair-unit-floor-v1'
audit=read(root/'training-unit-audit-v1.json');assert len(audit['rows'])==1000
groups=defaultdict(list)
for row in audit['rows']:
    old=np.asarray(row['control_units_FP32'],dtype=np.float32)
    new=np.asarray(row['candidate_units_FP32'],dtype=np.float32)
    assert old.shape==new.shape==(row['pairs'],)
    if len(old):groups[row['domain'],row['ADC_only']].extend((old/new).tolist())
actual=[]
for key,values in groups.items():
    ratios=np.asarray(values,dtype=np.float64);domain,adc=key
    expected=next(g for g in audit['unit_groups'] if (g['domain'],g['ADC_only'])==key)
    count=len(ratios);affected=int(np.sum(ratios>1));quantiles=np.quantile(ratios,[.5,.9,1]).tolist()
    assert count==expected['pairs'] and affected==expected['affected']
    assert quantiles==expected['unit_ratio_median_p90_max']
    assert np.all((ratios>=1)&(ratios<=8))
    actual.append({'domain':domain,'ADC_only':adc,'pairs':count,'affected':affected,
        'unit_ratio_median_p90_max':quantiles,'largest_quadratic_gradient_ratio':float(np.max(ratios**2)),
        'effective_ADC_weight':0 if adc else 1})
assert len(actual)==6 and sum(g['pairs'] for g in actual)==1382
assert sum(g['affected'] for g in actual if not g['ADC_only'])==620
output=repo/'docs/results/v164-training-unit-group-verification-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'pass-independent-all-actual-unit-group-reductions','actual_unit_audit':ref(root/'training-unit-audit-v1.json'),
    'groups':actual,'group_count_cells_checked':12,'group_quantile_cells_checked':18,
    'supervised_pairs':1240,'supervised_pairs_changed':620,'largest_unit_ratio':8,'largest_quadratic_gradient_ratio':64,
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forward_calls':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'scope':'Group counts/changed counts and FP32-ratio median/P90/max independently recomputed from1000 actual training-unit records,not copied from the proposed input-table groups. The64x/8x asymptotes describe gradients at fixed errors in quadratic/linear regimes,not actual global training-gradient ratios or trained quality. ADC pair changes have zero total supervision.'})
print('PASS six actual domain/ADC groups:12 count cells/18 quantile cells;620/1240 supervised pairs reweighted')
